title: Wave C: structural extraction (graph module, pipeline unification, MCP thinning)
description: Major structural refactor from 2026-05-08 checkpoint review. Architecture candidates #1, #2, #3 plus review findings F4, F5. This is the big refactor wave.

acceptance_criteria.text: Extract graph module: pull PageRank, BFS blast_radius, rollup computation from pipeline.rs into src/graph.rs. Interface: compute_rollups(db, files, changed_ids) and compute_pagerank(db, files).
Unify pipeline orchestration: shared post-parse sequence (resolve refs, build adjacency, compute rollups, compute PageRank, record snapshot) called by both parse_workspace and parse_changed_files.
MCP thinning: move arg structs from mcp.rs into their respective src/tools/*.rs modules. Investigate whether rmcp #[tool] can apply directly to tool module functions.
Fix F4: replace spawn_blocking + block_on in daemon.rs:173,266 with tokio::spawn for async parse functions.
Fix F5: introduce SnapshotParams struct for insert_snapshot (db.rs:841) to replace 9 positional i64 args.

execution_record:
All 5 ACs completed in a single commit (d2f229a). 230 tests pass, cargo check clean, cargo fmt applied.

AC1: Extracted graph.rs with build_file_adjacency, compute_rollups[_with_adjacency], compute_pagerank[_with_adjacency], bfs_blast_radius. Pipeline.rs shrunk from 865 to ~540 lines.
AC2: Shared post_parse_sequence + record_snapshot functions called by both parse_workspace and parse_changed_files.
AC3: Moved 20 arg structs from mcp.rs (1080 lines) to their tool modules. mcp.rs shrunk to ~850 lines.
AC4: Three spawn_blocking+block_on sites in daemon.rs replaced with tokio::spawn.
AC5: SnapshotParams struct with Default derive replaces 9 positional i64 args in insert_snapshot."

edges.note: Wave C after Wave A (fmt + quick fixes first so diffs are clean)
Wave C MCP thinning builds on Wave B workspace consolidation
Wave D deepening builds on Wave C structural extraction
